title: Restoring the omitted final proof value
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean word of length $m+2$, let $q$ be a Boolean proof word of length $m$, and let $k$ be an index among the $m+1$ positions of the proof word after appending a final true value. If the query addresses position $k$ in that extended proof word, then omitting the final proof position from the query, reading the resulting query on the input formed from $w$ and $q$, and restoring the omitted final value returns the value at position $k$ of the extended proof word.
